ntp_server.description: Primary NTP server to synchronize time with.

subnet.description: CIDR subnet from which clients may synchronize (set to '0.0.0.0/0' to allow all, but not recommended).

leapsec_tz.description: Time zone setting that includes leap seconds for TAI time support (e.g., 'right/UTC', 'right/UTC-tai').

log_dir.description: Directory where chronyd logs will be written.

ntp_port.description: UDP port on which the NTP server listens (123 is standard).

driftfile_path.description: Path to the file storing the system clock drift.

enable_auth.description: Enable NTP command authentication using keys (requires keyfile).

keyfile_path.description: Path to the file containing NTP authentication keys (used only if authentication is enabled).

makestep_threshold.description: Maximum time offset (in seconds) beyond which the clock is stepped (not slewn) at startup.

max_steps.description: Maximum number of steps allowed during initial slew (used with makestep).

leapfile_path.description: Path to the leap second table file (required for TAI time reporting).

smooth_start.description: If enabled, use initstepslew to smoothly correct large initial offsets instead of stepping.

max_slew_steps.description: Number of initial steps used by initstepslew when smooth_start is enabled.

enable_server.description: Enable chronyd to act as an NTP server for local clients (requires binding to localhost).

command_port.description: Port used for chronyd command interface (e.g., `chronyc tracking`).

enable_rtc.description: Enable synchronization with the hardware RTC (recommended for most systems).
